## Contract review

Reviewed at 2026-10-27T05:02Z — independent contract-review subagent, read-only, adversarial to the dispatch order, the seat and the dev's two reports. Everything below is a reading taken on `7d2aaefe` (branch `claude/project-thread-9von57`, merge-base `75afeffd`) and on `origin/main` at `d0a7e748`; nothing is adopted from the order or the reports without the reading beside it.

Head-sha: `7d2aaefe64523d85afb02b8d5f605cb85b43550d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/coordinator.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md, .claude/agents/os-dev.md, AGENTS.md, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs, scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs, scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs, scripts/pm/label-write.mjs, scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs, .github/workflows/lint.yml

Inputs read: card #26387 body and all 8 comments (triage first grade 6431784222 at 2026-10-27T01:53Z, dispatch order 6433338322 at 2026-10-27T03:54Z, claim 6433387320, amendment 6433559693 at 2026-10-27T04:12Z, the `domain:spec` seat's relay 6433564592, amendment 2 6433756084 at 2026-10-27T04:27Z, dev reports 6433731623 and 6433862534); PR #26467 body, file list, diff and check-runs re-fetched over REST at 2026-10-27T04:52Z; the seven files on the head and on `origin/main` via `git show`; the audit comment 6425678185 on #26184.

### ① Derived judgments

**Landing state read at 2026-10-27T04:52Z:** open, draft, `mergeable: true`, `mergeable_state: clean`, 3 commits (`500a14a8`, `50710116`, `7d2aaefe`), 7 files, +17/−17, labels `documentation`, `size/s`, `skip-changeset`, assignee os-warren, 0 PR comments before this one. The seven files are byte-identical between the merge-base `75afeffd` and `origin/main` (`git diff --stat` empty), so the diff reads the same against today's main.

**Tier and face.** All seven paths lie under objectstack's `.claude/**`, the one register row with a Tier S arm (`check-governed-merges.mjs` GOVERNED_SURFACES, 「席内达档复核落地」); no path is a Tier H row (`docs/adr/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `skills/**`, …) and no ADR or `AGENTS.md` is touched ⇒ Tier S holds: this record plus the seat's ACCEPT land it. The review tier is the ceiling by two routes: the maintainer's standing word for this lane (tap at 2026-10-27T00:33Z, words at 2026-10-27T01:22Z) and — contrary to the claim's own sentence — the path mandate: `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` on `origin/main` carries `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` as a MANDATORY_TIER_GLOB row (clause ①, narrowed 2026-08-20), and SKILL.md is in this PR's file list. The claim 6433387320 says 「`dispatch-gates --tier` prints no MANDATORY hit for `.claude/**`」; that is false for SKILL.md (to-do 1 below). The tier landed is the right one either way.

**(a) Item 1 — seat-settled scope against governing text.** `dispatch-runbook.md` L153–154 on the head: 「卡项与既裁冲突 ⇒ 席砍该项再派 ⛔ 不问分诊;行首 `Ruling-ref:` 引既裁出处,原话逐字。」 and 「其余砍范围、降级、关卡归人工地板 ⛔ 不借改卡裁;读数落认领 `Premise:` 行。」 Every required clause is there: the seat cuts the conflicting item itself, dispatches the remainder, writes a line-initial `Ruling-ref:` quoting the source verbatim, does not ask triage (no `pm:retriage`), and downgrades, closes and every other scope cut stay on the human floor. `SKILL.md` L112 (`pm:retriage` row) names the two settled asks as 「归执行席 ⛔ 不问」; `triage-duties.md` L78 sends them back 「退回执行席」. `Ruling-ref:` is a key `check-prior-rulings.mjs` already reads as a pointer, never a ruling (its self-test L1610) — the body's claim about it holds. The floor line `triage-duties.md` L83 still lists 砍半 without the exception; L90's 不呈 list carries 既裁执行, which is what the new line relies on — readable, one clause short (to-do 6).

**(a) Item 2 — lane move for a whole-tree remainder.** `execution-duties.md` L9–10: 「席改标:卡余项实测路径整落本席包树 ⇒ 本席改 `domain:*`,审计评论列路径与新旧标同笔。」 and 「席改标限未派发卡;带 `needs-user-decision`、open `Blocked-by:` 或 `security` 的 ⛔ 不改,仍问分诊。」 All four limits survive in the text (undispatched only; `needs-user-decision`, open `Blocked-by:`, `security` still go to triage), the audit comment lists paths and old/new labels, and the relabelling seat is the owning lane's (「本席」). `SKILL.md` L34, `cross-repo-coordination.md` L32/L40, `lanes/ui.md` L8, `triage-duties.md` L76 all point at the same term 席改标. Mechanically executable: `label-write.mjs` on `origin/main` has no `domain:*` refusal for an execution seat; `check-half-states.mjs` reads `domain:*` only for H13 (domain without pm-state). Left-over tension, not a contradiction: `SKILL.md` L170 「`domain:*` 只由分诊产出,两例外」 and `cross-repo-coordination.md` L4 「中央分诊是 `domain:*`…的唯一生产者」 speak of first production, the new rule of a relabel; a reader has to hold that distinction (to-do 7).

**(a) Item 4 — the seat derives tier and effort; the maintainer's word is no precondition.** `dispatch-runbook.md` L138–139: 「档位与 effort 席位自推导 ⛔ 不等维护者原话:`--tier` 过路径,MANDATORY 即绑;effort 按难度。」 and 「派发令写两者与推导(`--tier` 行或难度读数),协调者照令开线程;常设原话有则作 `reason:`。」; `coordinator.md` L33: 「按派发令所写的 model 与 effort 开线程,⛔ 不等维护者原话;常设原话有则席位引作 `reason:`。」 That is amendment 2's shape exactly: derivation by `--tier` with MANDATORY binding, effort by difficulty, both written with the derivation into the order, the coordinator opens as ordered, no waiting, a standing word cited as `reason:` where one exists. My own grep of 原话 / 明言 / 常设 / 逐卡 over the seven head files finds no remaining sentence that conditions a thread's model or effort on a maintainer message: 明言 has zero hits; the other 原话 hits (`dispatch-runbook.md` L99, L153; `execution-duties.md` L84, L179; `SKILL.md` L25, L145, L256) are different rules. Two lines keep a maintainer word as a source without making it a precondition, both by the ruling's own text: `execution-duties.md` L118 「`max` 凭点名或常设令」 (the effort ladder is the derivation amendment 2 names) and the `SKILL.md` L311 template 「同行引其 MANDATORY 路径行或 reason:(逐卡裁决,或常设档位令的 id 与时刻)」 — the `post-stamped` refusal of an underived ceiling that amendment 2 says stays. Spelling check against the tools on `origin/main`: `readContainerModelLine` (`dispatch-gates.mjs`) accepts the ceiling on `/\bMANDATORY\b/` or `/\breason[ \t]*:/i`, and `post-stamped.mjs` imports `containerModelRefusal` from it; the template's 「reason:(…)」 matches the second regex, so what the template now teaches is a spelling both accept, and a ceiling with neither is still refused before the write.

**(a) Item 3 is absent.** `SKILL.md` L119 (`area:*` row, 「同轴至多一个在飞,除非文件面不相交」) is unchanged on the head; no hunk touches area-axis or hot-file serial text.

**(b) The 17 cut lines are duplicates or in-place rewrites, none a lost rule.** Thirteen of the seventeen deletions are the "before" halves of in-place rewrites (each paired with an "after" line in the same hunk). The four genuine retirements, each read against its claimed home on the head: (1) `dispatch-runbook.md` 「终报 `needs_decision` ⇒ 席位附四维分析与推荐,并入决裁批次呈维护者裁;⛔ 无裁决线程。」 — survives whole at `SKILL.md` L220, `coordinator.md` L38 and `lanes/director.md` L21–22. (2) `dispatch-runbook.md` 「容器重启杀本地后台循环:席位等服务端信号(PR 订阅事件、座位 Routine),本地 watcher 可选。」 — the rule (wake by PR subscription and routine, nothing local to chain) survives at `SKILL.md` L71; the measured fact behind it survives at `platform-readings.md` L363; only the parenthetical 「本地 watcher 可选」 has no verbatim home — a permission, not an obligation, so nothing a seat must do is lost. (3) `execution-duties.md` L91 「模型分档是 PM 的逐卡显式决定;档位值单源在 dispatch-gates 常量,⛔ 本文不写模型名。」 — 「⛔ 不抄模型 id」 and 「天花板拼常量名」 at L72, 「档位逐次派发显式传参,永不省略」 at L116; the 「逐卡显式决定」 half is exactly what item 4 replaces with derivation, so retiring it is coherent rather than lossy. (4) `execution-duties.md` L140 「对外发布的技能包是平台最大的对外价值,评估恒整包整体。」 — a rationale; its operative rule survives at L182 (整包价值密度, read from the client agent's seat). Smaller losses inside rewrites, all readable from a neighbouring line: `triage-duties.md` L78 dropped the explicit 「标照摘」 for inbox cases (the new line's 「同笔摘标」 is per fire, so the label still comes off, but it no longer says so for the inbox arm); `execution-duties.md` L62 dropped 「自队列重新认领」 and the non-whole-tree lane change (L61 already returns the card to `pm:queue`; `SKILL.md` L112 keeps 改路由 with triage) (to-do 8).

**AGENTS.md** is untouched (not in the file list) and a grep of `origin/main` AGENTS.md for `Ruling-ref`, `domain:*`, `retriage`, `--tier`, 席改标 finds nothing: no new line restates an AGENTS.md rule.

**(c) Ratchet — read from the script, counted on the blobs.** CEILINGS on `origin/main` `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: SKILL.md 319, dispatch-runbook.md 245, coordinator.md 49, cross-repo-coordination.md 47, triage-duties.md 103, execution-duties.md 188, lanes/ui.md 23; widest-table-row pins SKILL.md 341, the six references 0. `wc -l` on `git show 7d2aaefe:PATH` gives 319 / 245 / 49 / 47 / 103 / 188 / 23 — each exactly at its ceiling, each equal to `origin/main` (headroom 0 → 0, no row moved, no raise claimed). Widest non-fence line on the head: 120 bytes in each of the six references (the cap the script's docblock names), 341 in SKILL.md at a pre-existing table row (L160, untouched; the pin). The rewritten `pm:retriage` row measures 329 bytes, as the body says. No run of the script was needed: CI's `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (lint.yml L937 `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, L947 `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`) is `success` on this head.

**(d) Check-runs on `7d2aaefe`, read at 2026-10-27T04:52Z:** 46 check-runs, none in progress, none red — 27 `success`, 19 `skipped` (the path-filtered build/test lanes, as expected for a `.claude/**` diff). The gate lanes for this surface, by reading lint.yml on `origin/main`: `Lint · repo & tooling gates` carries the line ratchet and the skill-id lint (success); `Lint · docs & code guards` carries `check:role-word` (L2249, success — its ROOTS are `content/docs` and `skills`, so `.claude/**` is outside it anyway); `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` carries `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (L4768, success). The dev's one NOT-MEASURED family, `check:doc-formula-expressions`, runs at lint.yml L6237 inside `Type Check · consumer gates` (success), not in 「Lint & Repo Gates」 as both reports say — a mislabel of the lane, not a gap. The seat-side gates `No other open PR may claim the same issue`, `…same single-writer path`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are all `success`.

**(e) PR body — the nine amendments and the quoted blocks.** The live body (re-fetched, 21133 bytes) differs from the dev's original of 2026-10-27T04:26Z in exactly the nine places report 6433862534 lists (速读 ③, 速读 为什么改, What-changes intro, Item 4 title and Ruling-ref, the runbook L138 after-block, the coordinator L33 after-line, the SKILL.md template paragraph, the deleted Acceptance bullet, the three head-sha sentences) — all nine applied, nothing else moved. Every fenced "after" line in the body (16 blocks) is byte-identical to a line on the head, and every "before" line to a line on `origin/main`; the four retired lines quoted in prose exist on `origin/main` and not on the head. Line 1 is the harness attribution comment, line 2 the harness `_Requested by_` line, line 3 `Fixes #26387`, lines 4–5 `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, all line-initial; the two closing-keyword gates passed on this shape. 速读 carries the six labels in order (改了什么 / 为什么改 / 风险与回滚 / 先看 / 两分钟验证 / 需要你做的) with 需要你做的 = 无 — right for Tier S. The Item 4 `Ruling-ref` cites the maintainer by time and by comment ids 6433564592 and 6433756084; the items 1–2 `Ruling-ref` cites the card body's quotes by time (the source is the card body, which carries no comment id; the triage grade 6431784222 is cited one paragraph above). Deviations between the body and the files, none load-bearing: 风险与回滚 says 「七个文件的 18 行」 (the diff is 17 lines out, 17 in); 两分钟验证 says 「六个被改文件各自 headroom 0」 (seven files changed, seven rows in the body's own table); 先看 ② still labels the runbook's two 卡线程 lines 「常设档位令」, the first shape's name, while the lines now teach self-derivation; the second half of 两分钟验证 (`git grep` 「每处都与新规则一致」) is a judgment, not a sight. (to-do 4)

**(f) Reports.** Both carry `deviations`, `line_budget`, `out_of_scope_findings` and the branch of the claim. The deviation 「Part A has no pm-dispatch section」 is true: comment 6425678185 has sections per published skill and a card list, and mentions pm-dispatch once, pointing at Part B. `mcp_calls: 0` is stated for GitHub MCP; report 1 also says the remote-control server's `get_session` was called once — a non-GitHub MCP call, outside the order's ban but inside the count the line names (to-do 5). `api_writes` 3 then 2, endpoints named. The PR body was written once by the dev and patched once by the seat at 2026-10-27T04:47Z, as os-dev.md's one-write rule and the report's `body_amendments` hand-off describe.

**Wording left for the seat (precision, not contract):** `dispatch-runbook.md` L139 spells the coordinator 协调者 while L134–137 and L141 of the same section spell it `coordinator`; one concept carries three spellings across the set — 常设原话 (L139, coordinator L33), 常设档位令 (SKILL.md L311), 常设令 (execution-duties L118); `dispatch-runbook.md` L135 still has the seat hand the coordinator a 「建议 effort」 while L139 has the order set it.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: the diff is `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` only, no package.json exists under that tree on `origin/main`, nothing is published; `Check Changeset` is `skipped` on the head, `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are line-initial on the body. No `Skills-docs:` line is owed (`Metadata-protocol: none`).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Card candidate (skills lane): `dispatch-runbook.md` L56 「配方:`issue_read get` 拿评论总数…」 spells a GitHub MCP tool in a fleet whose every read is REST; `platform-readings.md` L228–L312 carry five more `issue_read` mentions as measured platform readings (history, not instructions). The dev noted it and did not file it. Dedupe words: `issue_read get 尾页 REST per_page page 读数成本`.
- Card candidate (skills lane, os-dev.md): `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` L273 says 「正文首行 `Fixes #N`」 and L323 exempts 「harness 自写的 PR 正文首行归属注释…`Fixes #N` 紧随其后」; the harness now writes two lines (the attribution comment and a `_Requested by_` line) before `Fixes`, which is what this PR and the sibling skills PRs carry. The closing-keyword gates accept it; the text should name the two-line block. Dedupe words: `os-dev.md Fixes 首行 harness attribution _Requested by_ 两行`.
- Not a card: the claim's tier-derivation sentence (SKILL.md is a MANDATORY row) — a one-line correction on the card by the seat; the body's 18-lines / six-files / 常设档位令 wordings — a body patch if the seat wants the body exact; the lane mislabel for `check:doc-formula-expressions` — nothing to change in the repo.
- Base reconciliation: the PR's recorded base is `67461403`, its merge-base with `origin/main` (`d0a7e748` after `git fetch`) is `75afeffd`, and the seven files are identical on both; `mergeable_state: clean`.
- Done-when: the card's last line asks for the spec lane's 「dispatchable / open `pm:queue`」 ratio to be re-read on the card after landing; the body records 0/9 before and after at 2026-10-27T04:02Z — that re-read on the card is the seat's, after merge.

## 维护者速读
改了什么:pm-dispatch 技能三条规则改由席位自己判——① 卡的一项与已接受 ADR 或已记录裁决冲突,席位砍该项、余项照派,卡上行首 `Ruling-ref:` 逐字引出处,不再挂 `pm:retriage`;② 余项按实测文件清单整个落在某车道包树里,该车道席自己改 `domain:*`,审计评论同笔列路径与新旧标签;③ 卡线程的档位与 effort 由席位推导(`dispatch-gates --tier` 过路径定档,effort 按难度)写进派发令,协调者照令开线程,⛔ 不等你一句话;你说过的常设原话有则引作 `reason:`。限制留着:只对未派发卡;`needs-user-decision`、open `Blocked-by:`、`security` 仍走分诊;降级、关卡、其它砍范围仍归人工。卡第 3 项(同轴串行改按文件面)按你 04:10Z 的 B 没写。
为什么改:你 10-27 的原话「这种问题为什么要问分诊,你可以自己判断」「你两个座位可以处理10张卡啊,问题不在座位」,和 04:11Z 「这种为什么需要我确认,你应该自己决定」;#26076 为一句档位确认等了近三小时,spec 车道 13 张队列卡只派得出 3 张。
风险与回滚:七个 `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` 文件 +17/−17 行,行数不变、棘轮 headroom 0,无脚本无门禁无发布面;回滚 = revert 本 PR(三个提交)。风险在措辞读宽,复审逐句核过限制条款都在。
先看:① `references/dispatch-runbook.md` L138–139(席位自推导)与 L153–154(`Ruling-ref:`);② `references/execution-duties.md` L9–10(席改标);③ `SKILL.md` 认领模板 `reason:` 占位。
两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 全绿、七文件各印 headroom 0;`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --files .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 仍印 MANDATORY。
需要你做的:无。Tier S(全部路径在 `.claude/**`),契约复核 PASS + 本核对后席位自己 ready 并布自动合并。
席位意见:同意落地。两条后续归席位:认领 6433387320 的推导句说 `.claude/**` 无 MANDATORY 命中,实测 `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` 对 `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 有 MANDATORY 行,档位对、推导句错,落地记录里更正;三处措辞精修(`triage-duties.md` L83 地板行缺既裁冲突例外、`SKILL.md` L170 未点名席改标、常设原话/档位令/令三种拼法)进下一张 pm-dispatch 卡。

## 席位核对

**ACCEPT** · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn` · 2026-10-27T05:07Z — seat review of record for #26387 on head `7d2aaefe`, against GitHub, not the report's own account. Every changed path sits under objectstack `.claude/**` (the register's one Tier S row); no `skills/**`, no ADR, no AGENTS.md ⇒ **Tier S**: the record of the review tier is the independent `## Contract review` at comment 6434191962 (`Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, head `7d2aaefe`, `VERDICT: PASS`, `Local-runs: none`; drafted by a reviewer other than the implementer, the card thread's dev). This seat adds the landing read and lands it itself.

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, `mergeable: true` (`clean`), three commits (`500a14a8` items 1+2, `50710116` item 4 first shape, `7d2aaefe` item 4 widened to the maintainer's 04:11Z word); body lines 1–2 the harness attribution block, line 3 `Fixes #26387`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial; `## 维护者速读` six labels in order (the seat patched the dev's nine `body_amendments` at 2026-10-27T04:47Z and three precision lines — 17 lines not 18, seven files not six, the 先看 ② label — before this record). Files: `SKILL.md`, `references/coordinator.md`, `cross-repo-coordination.md`, `dispatch-runbook.md`, `execution-duties.md`, `lanes/ui.md`, `triage-duties.md` — seven, +17/−17, exactly the claim's surface (claim 6433387320, amendments 6433559693 and 6433756084). Branch `claude/project-thread-9von57`, named by the claim.
2. **Record, measured.** The reviewer read items 1, 2 and 4 clause by clause against the card and the two amendments (runbook L153–154, execution-duties L9–10, runbook L138–139 + coordinator L33), confirmed item 3 absent (SKILL.md L119 area row unchanged), grepped 原话/明言/常设/逐卡 on the head for any surviving precondition (none), checked the template's `reason:` spelling against `readContainerModelLine` and that `post-stamped` still imports `containerModelRefusal` (an underived ceiling is still refused), traced each of the four retired lines to a surviving home, and recomputed the line ratchet from the script on `origin/main` (319/245/49/47/103/188/23, all equal to main, non-fence lines ≤120 B, widest SKILL.md row 341 = pin). Body after-blocks byte-identical to the head files. The seat re-read the diff and reads the same.
3. **Gates, pinned to head `7d2aaefe`.** 46 check-runs, 27 success and 19 skipped, none red or pending (reviewer's read 2026-10-27T05:02Z); `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (line ratchet + id-lint), `Lint · docs & code guards` (role-word), `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, the claim/closing guards all success. The dev's local union: 22 families derived, 21 run exit 0, `check:doc-formula-expressions` NOT-MEASURED locally — success on CI in `Type Check · consumer gates`.
4. **Accepted deviations.** (a) `Fixes` on line 3 behind the harness's two attribution lines. (b) Branch is the thread's harness branch. (c) `pr_create` through the relay, 0 GitHub-MCP calls (one remote-control `get_session`, outside the ban).
